xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex054022026-02-1912-48-57" status="finalized">yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3878">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3878">khro po</rs><note type="editorial">Identification of khro po only found in ID:5990 as gloss</note></note> sngags dang rdzas kyi nus pas dbang shes kyis sa <expan>'og gi</expan> gter mthong ba dang | bskal ba'i sgra thos pa <lb edRef="inst:4943" n="10b3"/> <expan>la sogs</expan> pa ni chod pa'i don la 'jug <app><lem wit="inst:4943">pas</lem><rdg wit="inst:4943">pas</rdg><rdg wit="inst:5990">pa</rdg></app> tshad ma ma yin gyi rkyen gzhan shes <expan>yin no</expan> <app><lem wit="inst:5990">zhes</lem><rdg wit="inst:4943"/><rdg wit="inst:5990">zhes</rdg></app> zer ba ni ma yin <lb edRef="inst:5990" n="8b5"/> <app><lem wit="inst:5900">te</lem><rdg wit="inst:4943">ste |</rdg><rdg wit="inst:5990">te</rdg></app> tshad ma'i <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> tshang ba'i phyir dang | lha'i mig <expan>la sogs</expan> pa la ha cang thal ba'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
